description: Use when the user asks about one Steam account itself - nickname, avatar, profile visibility, creation date, online status, current game - and nothing else. Returns the raw GetPlayerSummaries object plus SteamID conversions; cheapest profile tool, data no older than 48 hours, unknown profiles are fetched live from Steam. Private profiles return the public subset of fields (not an error); unresolvable ids return an error result. Do not use for bans, FACEIT or friends (steam_summary or the narrow tools).

id.description: any SteamID format: steamid64 (17 digits), STEAM_1:0:x, STEAM_0:0:x, [U:1:x], hex, steam:hex, a 32-bit account id, a steamcommunity.com link or a vanity name

name: steam_profile

ids.description: the same account in every SteamID format
